entities.name: Penthikos
entities.description: A human hero of Theros from Akros whose life ended in tragedy.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City Penthikos defended and which sentenced him.

entities.name: Oromai
entities.description: The king of Akros who sentenced Penthikos.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun under which Penthikos was chained.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose anvil the rock is compared to.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who answered Penthikos's prayer.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God who ferries souls across the River of the Dead.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Undead phalanxes that overwhelmed the Akroan ranks.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead that Penthikos crossed into.

entities.name: River of the Dead
entities.description: River crossed to reach the Underworld.

entities.name: Phoberos
entities.description: Badlands where the Akroan stratians were slaughtered.

events.summary: Penthikos breaks formation in the Phoberos badlands and charges ahead alone.
events.quote: Breaking formation and running ahead, he struck down enemies as fast as they came at him

events.summary: The Akroan ranks fall into disorder and drown under the advancing Returned while Penthikos is cut off.
events.quote: he heard his shieldmates curse him as they died

events.summary: Penthikos reports to the king of Akros, who sentences him to be chained to the rocks.
events.quote: And so he was chained to the rocks , to die in the sun of Heliod .

events.summary: Penthikos prays for atonement and Erebos answers, freeing him to enter a cave.
events.quote: Erebos 's great voice filled the air, acknowledging his prayer

events.summary: In the dark cave Penthikos cuts down shades, each death tearing at his soul.
events.quote: the death of each shade ripped at his heart and soul

events.summary: At the River of the Dead a scholar of Athreos refuses him passage until a death mask forms on his face.
events.quote: he felt the matter on his face shift and sculpt itself into a grimacing death mask

events.summary: Penthikos is ferried across to the Underworld to take his place among the dead.
events.quote: the ancient barge silently slid forth from the fog

relations.quote: The king of Akros pronounced a sentence over Penthikos
stood heroically on Pharagax Bridge in defense of Akros
Penthikos explained he had made a deal with Erebos
